form.description: What is happening in the parks right now?

search.query: `queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride | stats latest(park_name) as park_name by park_id | sort park_name

div.p: What is happening in the parks right now?

search.query: `queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | sort 0 - _time | dedup park_id ride_id | eval age_seconds=now()-_time, source_epoch=strptime(last_updated,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3NZ"), source_age_minutes=round((now()-source_epoch)/60,1), open=if(is_open="true",1,0), open_wait=if(open=1,wait_time,null()) | stats count as Rides

`queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | sort 0 - _time | dedup park_id ride_id | eval age_seconds=now()-_time, source_epoch=strptime(last_updated,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3NZ"), source_age_minutes=round((now()-source_epoch)/60,1), open=if(is_open="true",1,0), open_wait=if(open=1,wait_time,null()) | stats sum(open) as Open

`queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | sort 0 - _time | dedup park_id ride_id | eval age_seconds=now()-_time, source_epoch=strptime(last_updated,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3NZ"), source_age_minutes=round((now()-source_epoch)/60,1), open=if(is_open="true",1,0), open_wait=if(open=1,wait_time,null()) | stats avg(open_wait) as Minutes | eval Minutes=round(Minutes,1)

`queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | sort 0 - _time | dedup park_id ride_id | eval age_seconds=now()-_time, source_epoch=strptime(last_updated,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3NZ"), source_age_minutes=round((now()-source_epoch)/60,1), open=if(is_open="true",1,0), open_wait=if(open=1,wait_time,null()) | stats max(age_seconds) as Minutes | eval Minutes=round(Minutes/60,1)

`queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | sort 0 - _time | dedup park_id ride_id | eval age_seconds=now()-_time, source_epoch=strptime(last_updated,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3NZ"), source_age_minutes=round((now()-source_epoch)/60,1), open=if(is_open="true",1,0), open_wait=if(open=1,wait_time,null()) | where open=1 | sort 0 - wait_time | head 15 | eval Ride=park_name." / ".ride_name | table Ride wait_time

`queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | sort 0 - _time | dedup park_id ride_id | eval age_seconds=now()-_time, source_epoch=strptime(last_updated,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3NZ"), source_age_minutes=round((now()-source_epoch)/60,1), open=if(is_open="true",1,0), open_wait=if(open=1,wait_time,null()) | stats sum(open) as Open count as Total by park_name | eval Closed=Total-Open | fields park_name Open Closed

`queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | sort 0 - _time | dedup park_id ride_id | eval age_seconds=now()-_time, source_epoch=strptime(last_updated,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3NZ"), source_age_minutes=round((now()-source_epoch)/60,1), open=if(is_open="true",1,0), open_wait=if(open=1,wait_time,null()) | eval Status=if(open=1,"OPEN","CLOSED") | sort 0 park_name - wait_time | table park_name land_name ride_name Status wait_time source_age_minutes last_updated

`queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | sort 0 - _time | dedup park_id ride_id | eval age_seconds=now()-_time, source_epoch=strptime(last_updated,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3NZ"), source_age_minutes=round((now()-source_epoch)/60,1), open=if(is_open="true",1,0), open_wait=if(open=1,wait_time,null()) | eval latitude=tonumber(latitude),longitude=tonumber(longitude) | geostats latfield=latitude longfield=longitude avg(open_wait)
